feeds.title: nwaMotherlode
feeds.description: nwaMotherlode.com is an interactive, online magazine for women and families in Northwest Arkansas. Like any busy mom, this site knows how to multi-task: recipes, blogs, advice, Northwest Arkansas calendar, weekend events + legendary giveaways.

feeds.title: Ever Thine Home Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts covers artciles on lifestyle, faith, motherhood, parenting and more. Barbara is the creator and founder of Ever Thine Home.

feeds.title: Flour on My Fingers
feeds.description: I'm Mel, the blogger behind Flour on My Fingers and Adventures of Mel. Sharing simple, delicious, from scratch dessert recipes, baking recipes and baking tips, sweet breakfast and brunch recipes, and beverages.

feeds.title: Tricia Goyer Blog
feeds.description: From parenting to marriage, homeschooling to mommy tips, Tricia Goyer shares variety of topics on her blog. Tricia Goyer writes out of her passion for God and her love for family and others. The author of more than 70 books, she writes both historical fiction and nonfiction related to family and parenting.

feeds.title: Sarah Fortune
feeds.description: Sarah Fortune's blog, penned by Sarah herself, offers a heartfelt glimpse into her life as a devoted mom to Iris and a loving wife to Todd. Nestled at the base of the picturesque Ozark Mountains in Fayetteville, Arkansas, their cosy family finds joy in sharing snippets of their cherished moments. Through her blog, Sarah encapsulates the beauty of everyday life, weaving tales of love, laughter, and the simple pleasures found in their idyllic surroundings.

feeds.title: The Maternal Hobbyist
feeds.description: Empowering parents around the globe through play-based learning, pregnancy, and travel while navigating gluten-free needs.

feeds.title: Country Life City Wife
feeds.description: Country Life City Wife's blog chronicles the daily experiences and thrilling adventures of a dedicated mother. Juggling roles as a stepmom, fur mom, and lizard mom, she embraces the challenges and joys of her city-to-country shift, embracing discoveries each day. With a professional background in science and medical education, she flourishes in the realms of experiential marketing and brand strategy, enriching her journey with diverse perspectives and skills.

feeds.title: Love, Mom Blog
feeds.description: Meet Holly, a mother to four children ranging from 11 to 22 years old, with two currently navigating college life and two bravely managing type 1 diabetes. Holly has experienced the roles of both a stay-at-home mom and a classroom teacher, finding both to be simultaneously rewarding and challenging.In her Love, Mom Blog she shares the activities in her life, adventures with family, family drama, events occasion, celebrations and gives all the details of it to other regular readers.

feeds.title: Arkansas Girls
feeds.description: Arkansas Girls Blog, curated by a dynamic mom-daughter duo, offers a delightful peek into their lives. Primarily centred on kid-friendly recipes curated by their mother, the blog also offers insights into their daily adventures. Based in central Arkansas, it celebrates kid-centric fun, featuring tween fashion, gift guides, party ideas, and travel escapades, encapsulating the essence of childhood joy and exploration.

feeds.title: Jennifer Maune
feeds.description: Jennifer Maune, through her captivating blog, offers readers a window into her multifaceted life, brimming with daily events, adventures, and personal reflections. As a skilled home chef, entertainer, decorator, and photographer, Jennifer shares a wealth of expertise, from delectable recipes and cooking tips to insightful entertaining advice and decor inspirations. Jennifer's blog serves as a beacon of encouragement and inspiration, urging readers to live life beautifully amidst the hustle and bustle of daily routines.

feeds.title: Kelly's Korner Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kelly Stamps. I live in Northwest Arkansas. My passion is my relationship with my saviour - Jesus Christ! I blog so I can keep a record of our lives as a scrapbook but I also love having the opportunity to share my faith with the readers of my blog.

feeds.title: Shared Beginnings Blog
feeds.description: Shared Beginnings is an adoption agency in Arkansas providing resources and support for expectant mothers interested in making an adoption plan. Michaela is the author behind the blog and a mother herself.

feeds.title: Bolte Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Anna Bolte is a fitness professional that specializes in working with pregnant and postpartum women in Little Rock, AR and online.

feeds.title: The Mundane Moments Blog
feeds.description: The Mundane Moments exists to help busy mamas find meaning in the ordinary moments of the day. We celebrate the stories and experiences of mothers just like you - mothers being faithful in the ordinary, mundane moments.Let's let everything we think, say, and do be for God's glory.

feeds.title: Life of a tv mom
feeds.description: I'm mom to a 14-year old boy and an 12-year old girl. I'm a tv news anchor by profession and also I love helping people buy and sell real estate. Adventure and travels are my go to choice.

feeds.title: Shootin' The Breeze
feeds.description: The author of the blog was born in the great state of Texas, but raised in the Natural State, the Land of Opportunity, the state where one can experience four seasonal changes in two days, Arkansas. Her hobbies are running, hiking, reading, gardening, and traveling. She has learned that southern hospitality goes a long way, especially when accompanied by a good cup of coffee. Her husband is her best friend, the kids are perfect, and you can't tell her any different.

feeds.title: The Gifted Gabber
feeds.description: Planted in Arkansas, curated by Amy, stands as a vibrant testament to Arkansas living and lifestyle. As an esteemed Arkansas lifestyle blogger and digital influencer, Amy illuminates her journey of creating a warm, inviting home through a tapestry of recipes, travel escapades, entertainment insights, style inspirations, and home decor tips. From delectable recipes to captivating travel tales and stylish home decor with a penchant for plants, her blog resonates with fellow mamas seeking family-centric joy and teachers in pursuit of classroom inspiration and personal style.

feeds.title: Beauticurve Blog
feeds.description: Articles on plus size fashion, travel, beauty and more. Founded in January 2013, Beauticurve.com is a personal style blog written by Rochelle Johnson.

feeds.title: Stephanie Nunley Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie Nunley is a full service photographer specializing in fine art portrait photography, including maternity, newborn, and baby portraits. Studio is located in Bentonville, serving all of Northwest Arkansas.

feeds.title: Inviting Arkansas
feeds.description: Inviting Arkansas Magazine is the premier magazine in Central Arkansas dedicated to philanthropy and civic leadership. Michele is the owner and publisher of Inviting Arkansas. Visit the website are read the featured stories, events, articles, and more about Arkansas.
